question: If MEASURE is written as PHDVXUH, how is CULTURE coded?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is that each letter in the word is shifted forward by **3 positions (+3)** in the alphabetical series.

**For MEASURE : PHDVXUH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4abf96aacc441f30d537dba190c3536bb88072fb6e33f55841b996a9b8f95cff.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08c0362575e8c768d4e7d8a42c771c38433a73d74adde03487cc6da42260e966.png] 

Similarly, applying the same logic to **CULTURE**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/028c5127a5834ab8f1aaad9018ed546daec216daa26888363f9776fb43af9a5f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acec4641ac7322f52775f6eaf68d7433b8ae6a6c2a0de9f73d0f9ca725237812.png] 

 The resulting code is **FXOWXUH**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
